description: Use this when the user is still choosing a destination or an area to stay in. Returns how many hotels we score, the average Comfort Score, median price, where its hotels beat and trail the average hotel, the best neighbourhoods with their top hotel, which travel styles it suits, the city tax at a 4-star hotel, and when to go (pleasant, cool-night and quiet months, typical weather by month). A request for hotels (e.g. 'quiet hotels in Bangkok') is search_hotels' job. Read-only, no sign-in.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

location.description: City name or slug (an area such as Canggu gives its destination's overview).

name: get_city_overview
title: Destination overview
